name: Pope Linus
role: Head of the Catholic Church from c. 68 to c. 80
contribution: The bishop of Rome from c. 68 to his death in 80.

checks.lead: Pope Linus ( ; Greek: Λῖνος, Linos; died c. 80) was the bishop of Rome from c. 68 to his death in 80. He is generally regarded as the second bishop of Rome, after Saint Peter.  As with nearly all the early popes, he was canonized.
